source_text:
3.1 Περὶ
ἐλεφαντιῶντος ἵππου· Ἀφρικανοῦ Τὸ τοῦ χερσαίου ἐχίνου ἧπαρ ἐν ἡλίῳ ξηρανθὲν
ἰᾶται τοὺς ἐλεφαντιῶντας ἵππους.
pass_a_gloss: 3.1 Concerning of-a-horse elephantiasis-having. Of-Africanus. The of-the land hedgehog liver in sun having-been-dried heals the elephantiasis-having horses.
pass_b_english: On a horse with elephantiasis. Of Africanus. The liver of the land hedgehog, dried in the sun, heals horses that have elephantiasis.

choices.why: Medical: the participle of ἐλεφαντιάω. Not 'elephantine' as a look, and not an elephant.
χερσαῖος marks the land animal against the sea urchin (θαλάττιος ἐχῖνος at 3.15).

anf_compare.notes: No PD English of the Cesti body; ANF has the letters only.
